text_block_list.text:
Starting today is the "Summer Training Camp"—
Intensive training to improve skills begins.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's so hot...!
The glare from the ground is making me dizzy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, I always hear that how hard you train in the summer
is what really matters...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Since we're aiming for the Kikuka Sho and then the Tenno Sho (Spring),
we need to train thoroughly right here!
choice_data_list: My rivals are probably working hard too
My rivals are probably working hard too, huh

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please be strict with me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... how about we compromise on a maximum of two ice creams a day instead...?!

—A passionate summer training camp
with Special Week has begun.
